title: Lang Log languoid
description: One languoid of Lang Log. Lang Log does not sort languoids into families, languages, dialects or clades: every record has this one shape, and where it sits is its parent in each source. Whether a source calls it a family, language or dialect is that source's claim, kept as classification.<source>.level. Every value says which source and version it came from. The only labels Lang Log gives a languoid itself are its modality (spoken, signed, written) and whether it is constructed (an artificial or formal language); every languoid of every modality is in one tree.

id.description: Glottocode, or <source>:<id in that source> for a record that exists only in another source.

path.description: URL path below https://lang-log.github.io/, without leading or trailing slash; a historical stage ends in #<anchor>.

lang.description: Language tag of the name as the source gives it; empty when not given.

same_language.description: The name is recorded in the language itself (its tag matches the record's ISO 639-3 code).

classification.description: Place of this languoid in each source that classifies it: {<source>: {parent, level}}. parent is a Lang Log id or null (top of that source's tree); level is what that source calls it (Glottolog: family, language, dialect; WALS: family, subfamily, genus, language). The site nests languoids by Glottolog's parents.

modality.description: The physical medium: spoken (and its written use), signed, or a writing system.

constructed.description: An artificial or formal language (a conlang, a code, a programming or logical language).

features.description: Values of Lang Log features (features/index.json), keyed by feature id. A feature without data is left out.

value.description: Lang Log value id, chosen from the evidence by source priority.

disagreement.description: Present and true when the evidence gives more than one value.

feature.description: Feature id in that source, such as WALS 81A.

raw.description: The value as the source writes it.

record.description: The source's own id of the language the value was recorded for.

sources.description: Source id -> version of every source this record has data from.
